title: CS daily scratchpad - Acme Corp QBR + renewals
content:
Morning sprint notes / scratchpad - Acme Corp (AM: Noah Bennett)

Context: Quarterly business review scheduled 2026-04-15 10:00 PT (with execs). Renewal window opens 2026-05-01. Current ARR: $120k. Primary contacts: Sarah Ortiz (IT), Ben Walker (Product), CTO: Lina Park.

Top objectives for today:
- Finalize QBR deck draft and get Maya to review by EOD.
- Confirm renewal pricing recommendation and internal approvers.
- Follow up on open support tickets with engineering (SUP-993, SUP-1001).
- Prep usage/latency slides showing improvements after 3/28 infra tuning.

QBR deck todo (quick checklist):
- Slide: "State of the integration" - latest uptime/latency (ops asks Jordan for updated numbers) -> ACTION: Jordan to send P50/P95 token latency and monthly SLO graphs by 1pm.
- Slide: "Cost/Utilization" - show committed vs overages; include Dedicated usage trend. Need cost export from billing. -> ACTION: Finance request: ticket to billing for detailed usage CSV (file id referenced in Confluence).
- Slide: "Success stories & wins" - include 2 customer quotes + case: search relevance improvement after rerank change. -> I have Ben's note from 3/22.
- Slide: "Risks / asks" - proposed autoscale bump for May traffic spike + optional private deployment pilot. -> Add estimated delta in monthly spend.
- Finalize appendix: list of resolved incidents and RCA (link to SUP-993).

Renewal notes:
- Term: 12 months starting 2026-05-01. Suggested uplift: 12% year-over-year (based on usage trend).
- Negotiation levers: commitment level (Dedicated pool), extended invoice terms, onboarding credits for new features.
- Internal approvers required: Head of Sales, Revenue Ops (Maya), Legal (TBD).
- ACTION: Draft renewal SOW + pricing doc and share with Maya for sign-off by 2026-04-13.

Support & follow-ups:
- SUP-993: intermittent KV cache invalidation causing latency spikes (incidents on 3/28, 4/02). ENG owner: Priya. Status: in progress. Need updated ETA for fix. -> ACTION: ping Priya in Slack + request status update for QBR slide.
- SUP-1001: embedding mismatch causing lower recall on product search. Workaround implemented. ENG ticket: progress on model rerank test. -> ACTION: request short writeup for "what we shipped" slide.
- Post-QBR follow-up items to capture: training session for Acme Data team, runbook for on-call procedures, joint roadmap session.

Meeting prep checklist (before 4/15):
- [ ] Final deck reviewed by Maya (due 4/10 EOD)
- [ ] Exec summary + ask bullets prepared (I will draft)
- [ ] Pricing recommendation + SOW (Maya + RevOps sign-off)
- [ ] Internal rehearse w/ Jordan + Maya (2026-04-14 11am PT)
- [ ] Send pre-read to Acme contacts (Sarah/Ben/Lina) by 4/13

Notes to self / loose ideas:
- Consider offering a one-time performance tuning engagement (2 weeks) as part of renewal to lock in higher commitment.
- Track NPS / satisfaction change after the embedding fix; use as a renewal selling point.
- Keep fallback model variant option handy in case of latency regression during demo.

Quick links (to pull metrics/content):
- Confluence QBR template: confluence:AcmeCorp-QBR-2026
- Support tickets: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SUP-993, https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SUP-1001
- Billing export request: jira:CS-BILL-58

Action items (assign and due):
- Noah: draft exec summary + ask bullets (due 2026-04-11)
- Maya: pricing + SOW draft (due 2026-04-13)
- Jordan: latency & SLO graphs (due 2026-04-10 1pm)
- Priya (ENG): fix ETA for SUP-993 (ask by EOD)

End of scratchpad. Keep live updates here as I get responses.

-- Noah
